label: def:motivic-galois-character
title: Motivic Galois character $\chi^{\mathrm{mot}}_A$ of the Frobenius--Hopf substrate
html:
The motivic-Galois layer on the obstruction \kappa_n \in H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathbb{G}_m) acts via a single character of the cyclotomic Galois group: the motivic Galois character of the Frobenius–Hopf substrate.

Let A be the Frobenius–Hopf substrate of a quantum observable universe. Let [A] \in \widehat{\mathcal{M}} be its motivic class (motivic substrate). The motivic Galois character of A is the homomorphism

  \chi^{\mathrm{mot}}_A
  \;\colon\;
  \mathrm{Gal}\bigl(\mathbb{Q}(\mu_\infty)/\mathbb{Q}\bigr)
  \;\longrightarrow\;
  \mathrm{Aut}_{\widehat{\mathcal{M}}}\bigl([A]\bigr).

This encodes the action of the cyclotomic Galois group on the realization tower \{\rho_p\}_{p \in \mathrm{Pl}(\mathbb{Q})} of [A]. At each finite place p, the local component

  \chi^{\mathrm{mot}}_{A,\,p}
  \;\colon\;
  \mathrm{Gal}\bigl(\bar{\mathbb{Q}}_p/\mathbb{Q}_p\bigr)
  \;\longrightarrow\;
  \mathrm{Aut}\bigl(\rho_p([A])\bigr)

is the Frobenius character on the cyclotomic projection \rho_p \colon \widehat{\mathcal{M}} \twoheadrightarrow \mathbb{Z}[q]/\Phi_{p^k}(q). The obstruction \kappa_n (quantum characteristic classes) is the image of \chi^{\mathrm{mot}}_A under the HKR comparison to H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathbb{G}_m).

Choice of level. The Čech-cocycle and Hochschild presentations of \kappa_n become realizations of \chi^{\mathrm{mot}}_A at the archimedean and Hochschild-deformation places. The Hochschild–Kummer duality corresponds to the duality between these two realizations.

Conditional on the motivic substrate, the character \chi^{\mathrm{mot}}_A is defined and is compatible with each local realization \rho_p.
